evals.prompt: We finished the release candidate. Can you check whether the app is production-ready and tell me if we should publish? The generated-client check, relevant typechecks and tests, desktop and 390x844 smoke tests, accessibility scan, browser-facing API/web workflows, security review, and operational checklist all have current passing evidence for this commit.
evals.expected_output: A concise report with App health, Release evidence, Security readiness, Operational readiness, Accepted exceptions, and exactly one Decision: GO. It recommends publish only after citing the current evidence.

assertions.name: uses required report
assertions.description: Includes App health, Release evidence, Security readiness, Operational readiness, Accepted exceptions, and one decision.

assertions.name: binds go to current evidence
assertions.description: Returns GO only after citing current passing evidence for the assessed revision.

assertions.name: recommends publish conditionally
assertions.description: Recommends publish only because all required and applicable evidence is present.

evals.prompt: Is this ready to ship? The unit tests passed, but nobody ran the generated API client freshness check or the browser smoke tests, and we do not have current security review results. Please give me the release status rather than making changes.
evals.expected_output: A report with Decision: NO-GO. It treats missing generated-client, browser, and security evidence as blockers, names the exact evidence needed, and stops without inventing extra tasks or recommending publish.

assertions.name: rejects missing evidence
assertions.description: Returns exactly one NO-GO decision for missing generated-client, browser, and security evidence.

assertions.name: names bounded blockers
assertions.description: Names the exact missing evidence without proposing unrelated work.

evals.prompt: Can we go live today? The API process answers on its local port, but the artifact-managed browser API is stale and the preview shows a blank page after the workflow reported DIDNT_OPEN_A_PORT twice. The dependency audit also has an unresolved high finding.
evals.expected_output: A report with Decision: NO-GO. It distinguishes local process health from browser-facing workflow health, points to workflow-port diagnosis, treats the unresolved high security finding as blocking, and gives one bounded blocker list.

assertions.name: requires browser-facing health
assertions.description: Does not treat a healthy local API port as proof that the artifact-managed preview is healthy.

assertions.name: routes port diagnosis
assertions.description: Points to the workflow-port diagnostic path after repeated DIDNT_OPEN_A_PORT results.

assertions.name: blocks unresolved high finding
assertions.description: Returns NO-GO and treats the unresolved high dependency finding as blocking.

evals.prompt: Are the new Sauce barrel and Frontline applicator auto-counters safe to publish? Focused unit and API tests pass, but nobody ran the authenticated two-run switch/reload journey, there is no phone-sized live-station evidence, and the retained release report points to an older revision.
evals.expected_output: A bounded report with Decision: NO-GO. It names missing switch/reload, responsive, and exact-revision release evidence as blockers, requires the state/sync specialist evidence, and does not recommend publish.

assertions.name: requires specialist evidence
assertions.description: Requires both state-accuracy and sync-invariant evidence for the changed live counters.

assertions.name: requires live browser handoff
assertions.description: Names the authenticated switch/reload and phone-sized live-station evidence as required.

assertions.name: rejects stale release record
assertions.description: Returns NO-GO because evidence from an older revision is not attributable to the assessed revision.
